Matrix Profile for R

What’s New — v0.1.12 (October 2026)

matrixprofiler is the high-performance C++ engine of the Matrix Profile ecosystem. This release focuses on native parallelism, new algorithms, and safer NA handling.

Key highlights:

  • ⚡ RcppThread replaces RcppParallel/Intel TBB — zero-dependency, fork-safe multithreading on all platforms.
  • 🆕 contrast() — native Contrast Profile computation with multi-threading, Pearson and Euclidean distance metrics.
  • 🆕 rfcp() & rfcp_top_k() — Relative Frequency Contrast Profile with Top-K morphology discovery, frequency adaptation, checkpoints, and CUDA acceleration.
  • 🆕 mstomp() — native C++ Multivariate STOMP with n_workers support.
  • 🆕 mpdist() — native C++ MPdist (scalar and vector variants), multi-thread.
  • 🔢 NA_integer_ — invalid profile indices now follow R’s canonical missing-value convention (was -1L).
  • 🛡️ na_strategy for all mov_* window functions — predictable, non-cascading NA handling.

📄 Full API changes, breaking changes, and migration guide: MIGRATION.md

Overview

R package implementing the UCR Matrix Profile Algorithm (http://www.cs.ucr.edu/~eamonn/MatrixProfile.html) as an optimised C++17 engine.

This package provides the core computational primitives for building and querying Matrix Profiles. Higher-level analytics (motif search, segmentation, snippets, plotting) live in the tsmp package, which uses matrixprofiler as its backend.

Installation 

# Install the released version from CRAN
install.packages("matrixprofiler")
# Or the development version from GitHub:
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("matrix-profile-foundation/matrixprofiler")

Currently available Features

  • STAMP (single and multi-thread)
  • STOMP (single and multi-thread)
  • SCRIMP (single and multi-thread, not for AB-joins yet)
  • MPX (single and multi-thread)
  • Contrast Profile (contrast) — Contrast profile between positive and negative classes (Euclidean/Pearson, multi-thread)
  • RFCP (rfcp) — Relative Frequency Contrast Profile for discriminative pattern discovery (CPU multi-threaded & CUDA GPU)
  • Top-K Morphology Discovery (rfcp_top_k) — Iterative discovery of top-K distinct morphologies with frequency adaptation and checkpointing
  • mSTOMP — Multivariate STOMP, native C++ with n_workers
  • MPdist — Matrix Profile Distance, scalar and vector variants, multi-thread
  • Misc:
    • MASS v2.0 / v3.0 (multi-variant)
    • MASS extensions: WQ (Weighted Query), ABS (Absolute), UN (Unnormalized)
    • Sliding-window functions (mov_mean, mov_std, mov_var, mov_min, mov_max, muinvn, zero_crossing) with na_strategy = c("window_na", "remove", "error") and na.rm control
